description: This Java source file defines an abstract class EntityConditionListBase that models a composite of multiple EntityCondition instances, combined with a logical operator. It is part of the Apache OFBiz framework's entity condition package, and provides methods to manage, evaluate, and generate SQL representations of combined query conditions.

classes.name: EntityConditionListBase
classes.description: An abstract class representing a list of entity conditions combined with a specified join operator, providing methods for condition management and SQL generation.

methods.name: getConditions
methods.description: Returns the list of condition expressions that are combined.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used to combine the conditions.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Retrieves a specific condition at a given index.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the condition list, as combined by the operator, is empty.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Generates the SQL where clause string based on the conditions, model entity, and datasource.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Validates the conditions against the model entity.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Checks if the conditions match a given map of values.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns an immutable EntityCondition representing the current combined condition.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another EntityConditionListBase.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the combined condition.
